card.name: Partway through kidney disease terms
card.fires_on: The middle piece of long kidney-related words such as membr-an-ous and prox-imal, right before the word is completed, mostly in warnings about glomerulonephritis or tubulopathy.

modes.label: Membranous glomerular disease
modes.description: The 'an' or 'ous' piece inside membranous or membranoproliferative before glomerulonephritis.

modes.label: Proximal tubule terms
modes.description: The 'imal' piece of proximal before renal tubulopathy or tubular nephropathy.
